en: Now you fight for me?

speaker: S0609
en: You failure.

speaker: S0609
en: So weak...so sad.

speaker: S0609
en: You want me, don't you? Your own sister...

speaker: S0609
en: There's something wrong with you, Vaas.

speaker: S0609
en: You didn't deserve me!

speaker: S0609
en: If you really wanted me, you would have come back!

speaker: S0609
en: You are a coward. A fool!

speaker: S0609
en: I will never love you, never!

speaker: S0609
en: Finally following through... Do it. Kill me.

speaker: S0609
en: Do what you came here to. Kill me!

speaker: S0609
en: Hurry up and do it, Vaas. Kill me. Do it!

speaker: S0609
en: Well, now's your chance. You came here to kill me, right?

speaker: S0609
en: It's all falling apart, isn't it? You are being transformed.

speaker: S0609
en: You see? I am tearing you down, making you new!

speaker: S0609
en: Aw, did killing me tear you up inside?

speaker: S0609
en: Good, now the rest.

speaker: S0609
en: Yes, do it. Do as I command!

speaker: S0609
en: You're doing what I want. I'm surprised.

speaker: S0606
en: Whatever, doesn't change shit.

speaker: S0606
en: He turned off a radio, I'm so scared.

speaker: S0606
en: Aw, I was listening to that.

speaker: S0609
en: A weak foundation, a weak mind. It's crumbling.

speaker: S0609
en: Once we tear you down to nothing, we can start to rebuild.

speaker: S0609
en: This is good. Destroy the old you, arise as my warrior.

speaker: S0609
en: Very good, Vaas. You've freed yourself. Take the blade. You've earned it.

speaker: S0609
en: Good work, Vaas. My lights will lead you to the blade.

speaker: S0609
en: Well, you did it. Let me show you your prize.

speaker: S0609
en: Yes! Tear yourself down. Move forward, as mine.

speaker: S0609
en: You're falling apart, and once you're broken...you'll bemine.

speaker: S0609
en: Fall apart, fall apart! Let the old Vaas die.

speaker: S0609
en: I told Jason to keep you locked up. A cage is where you belong. And if you try to free yourself...he's going to kill you.

speaker: S0606
en: Well would you look at that: someone's healing! Growing! Like I give a fuck.

speaker: S0606
en: Did somebody get a bit of self love? Feel a little better now?

speaker: S0606
en: Is that the power of self love or some shit? It heals? Namaste. I'm gonna kill you now.

speaker: S0606
en: Aw look at you! Healing as you free yourself. Now that's gotta be a metaphor, right?

speaker: S0609
en: Good boy! But you're not finished yet. Kill my warrior once again.

speaker: S0609
en: You've done as I asked. Now finish off Jason, and I will reward you.

speaker: S0609
en: You've actually done it. Now end Jason's life a final time, and I will give you want you want.

speaker: S0609
en: You can't blame me for everything wrong with you. You did this to yourself!

speaker: S0609
en: What does killing me accomplish? Do you think that will finally make you happy?

speaker: S0609
en: I am not the cause of your misery, Vaas. Ah, maybe I represent it, but that's all.

speaker: S0609
en: You had a future ahead of you! A path to follow, but you were too weak. Too distracted.

speaker: S0609
en: I was never enough for you! None of us were! You were driven only by greed, by cruelty.

speaker: S0609
en: Why are you angry with me? I tried to help you, but you didn't want it!

speaker: S0609
en: You were an embarrassment! I had to send a stranger to kill you, just to get it over with.

speaker: S0609
en: You turn your nose up at your birthright, and then act angry when I give it to another.

speaker: S0609
en: Argh, you entitled little boy! You could never do what I asked.

speaker: S0609
en: Smart-mouthed child. Always pushing back, always challenging me. Ugh, you will never change.

speaker: S0609
en: Oh, it is my fault, I suppose. I had such great expectations for you. But look at you. You were born to fail.

speaker: S0609
en: It's not my fault you failed so many times. It's not. I tried to help you.

speaker: S0609
en: Was it too much pressure, Vaas? Did I intimidate you? Did I ask too much?

speaker: S0609
en: Poor little Vaas, so angry, so weak. I know what you really want. You exude chaos but crave control.

speaker: S0609
en: I did what I was born to do! Dedicated my life to it! But you? You just walked away!

speaker: S0609
en: You hurt our people, you hurt me! Blame me all you like, but it was weakness that fueled you!

speaker: S0609
en: You always loved making me angry, didn't you? Well let me give you what you want: feel my rage!

speaker: S0609
en: We were supposed to protect each other. We promised we would always be by each others side... Why, why, why did you leave me?

speaker: S0609
en: You were my everything. You, you were meant to bring new life to our island. Instead? You-- you brought only death.

speaker: S0609
en: I-- I mourn for what could have been, if you had been stronger. If, if you had loved me enough.

speaker: S0609
en: Ugh, how could I ever love a man as broken as you? Huh? As if I would lower myself to that.

speaker: S0609
en: Ugh, you are nothing but a coward, hiding behind your words and laughter. Ugh. You repulse me.

speaker: S0609
en: Listen to what comes out of your mouth, it's vile! You aren't the warrior I need. How could you be?

speaker: S0609
en: You won't need a weapon here. It's just you and me.

speaker: S0609
en: Do you feel helpless without your gun, Vaas? Good.

speaker: S0609
en: I want you to watch. To pay attention. No guns to distract you.

speaker: S0609
en: Are you ready to remember? To reflect?

speaker: S0609
en: So many fond memories...

speaker: S0609
en: Maybe now you'll realize where you went wrong.

speaker: S0609
en: Look closely, pay attention.

speaker: S0609
en: Just watching isn't enough. Look harder.

speaker: S0609
en: Search the rooms, Vaas. Search your soul.

speaker: S0609
en: Isn't there something you can do? Aren't you paying attention?

speaker: S0609
en: You can only move forward. Do not go backwards.

speaker: S0609
en: There's another door open now, Vaas.

speaker: S0609
en: Find the next memory. Keep going.

speaker: S0609
en: Another room is open now, Vaas.

speaker: S05CB
en: That's badass.

speaker: S05CB
en: That's...justwow.

speaker: S06A7
en: Of course you do. I'm Raiza.

speaker: S05CB
en: My dad wanted me to be a dentist.

speaker: S0587
en: Before the accident, Chorizo used to follow me everywhere. Drove me crazy.

speaker: S0587
en: Then one day I sneak into an FND base for some parts. Didn't even know Chorizo was right behind me. Little buddy hits a tripwire and boom. Seeing him try to crawl to me... Worst day of my life.

speaker: S0587
en: But there was no time for tears. I scooped Chorizo up and took him straight to Carlos. He knows what's what with horses mostly but he saved Chorizo's life that day. As Chorizo healed up beside me, I perfected his new wheels.

speaker: S0587
en: That first day Chorizo tried them out, seeing him roll around so happy - still makes my heart explode, asere.

speaker: S0587
en: You ok, Bicho?

speaker: S0587
en: It's ok buddy, let it out.

speaker: S0609
en: Do you see that house, Vaas? That is a place to grow. Reflect. I'd go inside, if I were you.

speaker: S0609
en: When he comes, we show him no mercy - just like I taught you, like Jason has shown you.

speaker: S0609
en: You want to make me proud, don't you? Then deliver Vaas' body to me. Claim your victory.

speaker: S0609
en: If you really want me to be happy, if you really want to prove yourself...make sure Vaas dies here.

speaker: S0609
en: I hope you're ready...

speaker: S0609
en: Prepare yourself.

speaker: S0609
en: I want to look in your eyes as you die.

speaker: S0609
en: Enough games. I will kill you myself!

speaker: S0609
en: Are you ready, Vaas?

speaker: S0609
en: You survived. Your reward? Me!

speaker: S0609
en: Getting stronger with every kill, aren't you?

speaker: S0609
en: A good start Vaas, but you aren't finished yet.

speaker: S0609
en: You survived. I almost can't believe it.

speaker: S0609
en: That was good, Vaas. Now keep fighting for me.

speaker: S0609
en: Another battle won. Keep moving, keep killing.

speaker: S0609
en: Hello Vaas, are you ready to prove you've changed? Prove you are worthy?

speaker: S0609
en: So good to see you Vaas! Ready to fight for me? To prove yourself?

speaker: S0609
en: Ah, Vaas. Finally. Survive. Claim your birthright - show me you can be my warrior!

speaker: S0609
en: You are brave to even try this, Vaas. Brave to admit you want me.

speaker: S0609
en: I only want to help you. To love you for who you are, to worship the man you have become!

speaker: S0609
en: Yes, Vaas. More! Keep fighting, keep killing for me!

speaker: S0609
en: Slay your giants, Vaas! Become my warrior!

speaker: S0609
en: If you can do this, I will give you the power you desire. I will you give you everything!

speaker: S0609
en: You have been to the land of the dead, it's here - inside your mind. Now conquer it.

speaker: S0609
en: You are a warrior. You live for battle. Every man you fight dies and deserves to have his life taken from him!

speaker: S0609
en: Let me make a warrior out of you! Like you always wanted.

speaker: S0609
en: As long as you're fighting, you're with me. Stay. Kill.

speaker: S0609
en: Look at you, big, strong, powerful. Why would you want to go back to what you were?

speaker: S0609
en: This is a poison for the weak.

speaker: S0609
en: Only the strong survive.

speaker: S0609
en: This is your island.

speaker: S0609
en: The weight of your mistakes rain down on you.

speaker: S0609
en: You bring this upon yourself.

speaker: S0609
en: Feel the fire of your mistakes.

speaker: S0609
en: Kill them, kill them!

speaker: S0609
en: Show me your dedication.

speaker: S0609
en: Kill them, Vaas. Show me your strength.

speaker: S0609
en: Get ready for more.

speaker: S0609
en: You're not done yet.

speaker: S0609
en: I need more, more! Kill for me!

speaker: S0609
en: Let them fall at your feet!

speaker: S0609
en: Show me, show me again!

speaker: S0609
en: No! No, don't you dare escape, don't you leave me! Fight for me, die for me!

speaker: S0609
en: You, you cannot leave Vaas! You want to fight for me, don't you? Keep trying, just keep trying!

speaker: S0609
en: Don't-- don't you dare leave me, Vaas! You need to stay. You need to fight for me, forever!

speaker: S0609
en: If you go through that door, you'll forget about me! You'll move on! You will be miserable! Don't!

speaker: S0668
en: Now embrace my generosity and be healed.

speaker: S0668
en: I will forge my own path, find my own redemption - without you!

speaker: S0668
en: Try.

speaker: S0668
en: Do you remember yet? Do you understand what I have done for you? Return to our church. Stop this doubt and come back to me.

speaker: S067F
en: The sinners...they're all coming for us. Don't let them!

speaker: S0680
en: Bullied, abused, always alone. Until you found me, Father. I don't want to die. Please.

speaker: S0668
en: My sweet, innocent Faith. Your words... move me.

speaker: S067D
en: You can do this, Joseph. Just do like I taught you.

speaker: S067D
en: You see? They needed leaders - they needed to be conditioned! Without us? They're animals.

speaker: S067D
en: Show them, Joseph. Show them they can't fuck with the Seeds.

speaker: S067D
en: Never thought you'd be the one protecting me, Joseph. Life's funny that way, isn't it?

speaker: S067D
en: Good! Hunt! Kill! Sacrifice! Cull the herd!

speaker: S067D
en: Well done, Joseph. Keep moving.

speaker: S067D
en: Look at all these people. Thinking they're soldiers, turning on us. Hunt them, Joseph.

speaker: S0668
en: I know this isn't real. I know it. And yet...

speaker: S067D
en: You...you saved me, brother. Just like you said. Thank you.

speaker: S0668
en: We were only children, but still Jacob did whatever it took to keep us safe.

speaker: S067F
en: Yes! That's my big brother!

speaker: S067F
en: We could have just protected our family, but you pushed us to help others. We tried, and look how they're repaying us!

speaker: S067F
en: Please, I can't take anymore pain. I can't.

speaker: S067F
en: These people are so full of sin... the only option left is to put them down!

speaker: S067F
en: Look at them! They have nothing but darkness inside of them!

speaker: S067F
en: Free them from the burdens of their sin, Father!

speaker: S067F
en: After all we did for these people, after we freed their souls, prepared them for the collapse - this is what they do?

speaker: S067F
en: Make them sorry for turning their backs on us! Make them see! Make them say yes!

speaker: S0668
en: Thank you, John. Thank you.

speaker: S067F
en: You did it! You know, you always saw more than I could, knew more than I did. We were going to await the collapse together. And you would have saved us all.

speaker: S0668
en: All my life, I only wanted to protect him. My baby brother. I failed him... So many times.

speaker: S0680
en: I want to live, Father. Live with you.

speaker: S0680
en: You gave me a family, you gave me hope. Why do these people want to take it away?

speaker: S0680
en: Set them free, Father. Set them all free!

speaker: S0680
en: Why can't they see we were helping them? Giving them a purpose!

speaker: S0680
en: They don't walk the path...not anymore.

speaker: S0680
en: They want to take what we have built! They want to take it all from us!

speaker: S0680
en: You're my savior, Joseph. Just like you always said, just like... I always believed.

speaker: S067F
en: I just wanted to make you happy, I just wanted to help you!

speaker: S067F
en: Everything I did was for you. I followed the plan, Joseph. I followed your plan!

speaker: S067F
en: Where were you when I called? When my plane went down? I died alone, defending you?

speaker: S067F
en: Why didn't you let me kill that deputy? Why did you choose their life over mine?

speaker: S067F
en: If you had let me kill the deputy, I'd still be alive!

speaker: S067F
en: I saw how you looked at me. Deep down I disgusted you. I scared you!

speaker: S067F
en: Was it worth it, Joseph? Your life and the life of the deputy for everyone you claimed to love?

speaker: S067F
en: Did you even want me to survive? Or was I just a means to an end?

speaker: S067F
en: I can't believe I really thought you'd save me. After everything I saw, after everything I knew.

speaker: S0680
en: Remember what would happen when I failed you? Let me remind you!

speaker: S0680
en: Why did you do this to me? How can you live with yourself?

speaker: S0680
en: You chose me because I was helpless. You wanted prey. Well, I'm not helpless anymore.

speaker: S0680
en: I never wanted the Bliss! I came to you seeking escape - but you just gave me more!

speaker: S0680
en: Was my death part of your plan? Was the violence something you hoped for?

speaker: S0680
en: I lived in fear of you for so long!

speaker: S0680
en: Look at what you did to me. Look at what you turned me into!

speaker: S0680
en: You know, for a while? I actually thought I was lucky to be chosen by you.

speaker: S0680
en: I loved you. I loved you, and you used that to manipulate me. To ruin me!

speaker: S067D
en: When exactly did you turn soft on me? Was it when the Deputy arrived? Or earlier?

speaker: S067D
en: You aren't a solider. You're a scared little man who hid behind his family!

speaker: S067D
en: You are weak, selfish. You had so many chances to kill the deputy but you just couldn't do it, could you?

speaker: S067D
en: If I was in charge, if I was smart enough to have taken you out - we'd all be alive and well. 'Cept you.

speaker: S067D
en: Hey. Did I serve my purpose? Did I die right when you wanted me to?

speaker: S067D
en: You've already survived the collapse, you've already gotten what you wanted. Why are you doing this?

speaker: S067D
en: Oh, yeah. You were so happy to have me protect you, but happier when I was gone, weren't you?

speaker: S067D
en: You've been scared of me all your life. I could always see it.

speaker: S067D
en: How'd you feel when the deputy killed me? Bet you were just glad you didn't have to do it yourself!

speaker: S0668
en: Who was that?

speaker: S0668
en: Someone who came to judge you. Once an enemy...soon to be an ally. But not here, not yet.

speaker: S0668
en: My good works are rewarded.

speaker: S0668
en: A tool. To cleanse this place.

speaker: S0668
en: I will use this for good.

speaker: S0668
en: This will serve me well.

speaker: S0668
en: My sin is covering this place... But I will remove it, I will destroy it!

speaker: S0668
en: You see, Lord? I don't need you. This place is pure again.

speaker: S0667
en: What's wrong? You seem tired, or hurt. I mean...look for yourself.

speaker: S0667
en: If you want to get back to us, you're going to have to fight, right?

speaker: S0667
en: Here. This will make you feel better.

speaker: S0667
en: Are you ready now? Are you going to come and find us?

speaker: S0665
en: Now, be a good personification-of-my-flaws and tell me where I can find the other two pieces of this, would you?

speaker: S0667
en: Once upon a time, there was a king and goddess who fell deeply in love.

speaker: S0667
en: For the first time in the King’s life, he was truly happy! But having lived in misery for so long, he could see the goddess was not.

speaker: S0667
en: This made the king furious! He promised that what happened to the goddess would never happen again.

speaker: S0667
en: You've seen everything. You can go back now, if you want.

speaker: S0667
en: I guess that's the end of this story, huh? You can go back now...out the way you came.

speaker: S0667
en: If you've seen enough, if you want to leave, you can go back out. It's okay.

speaker: S0667
en: That's everything! Time to get back to saving me and mommy, right? You can use the door that you came in from.

speaker: S0667
en: That's somewhere safe, Daddy! You can go in there and everything will be OK!

speaker: S06AF
en: Choose your path and follow the tunnel. If you pass my tests, if you remember who made you king - I'll give you your throne back.

speaker: S06AF
en: You see those tunnels? Go through them. Both. Remember the man you were, show me he's still in there.

speaker: S06AF
en: Fight your way through those tunnels. Survive, be ruthless. Then, I'll give you what you deserve.

speaker: S06AF
en: If you want the throne, you'll go through those tunnels and pass the tests I've laid out for you.

speaker: S06AF
en: You've forgotten who you are. Who you were. Fight your way through those tunnels, prove you deserve this throne.

speaker: S06AF
en: You know Pagan, you probably won't win if you go up against me. Why not jump here? It'll be a quicker death.

speaker: S06AF
en: Hey Pagan, the rocks below will be kinder than I will. Why not just kill yourself now?

speaker: S06AF
en: You should just jump, Pagan. Just die. It'll hurt less than what I'll do to you.

speaker: S06AF
en: Are you really ready to fight me? There's always the option for a quick death...if you jumped from here.

speaker: S06AF
en: I want you to burn, Pagan. So leave those braziers alone!

speaker: S06AF
en: You'll get cold if you turn those fire pots off, Pagan. Wouldn't you hate that?

speaker: S06AF
en: Stay away from those fire pots! I lit them just for you. It's fun to watch you burn, do you want more?

speaker: S06AF
en: Don't even think about turning off those fire pots. You'll leave them burning or you'll regret it!

speaker: S06AF
en: You like the fire, don't you? Like the challenge? Then leave those braziers lit!

speaker: S06AF
en: I'm impressed, but you're not done yet. The next tunnel is waiting.

speaker: S06AF
en: So what, you passed one test. There's still another.

speaker: S06AF
en: Yeah, yeah. Try not to get cocky, I have a whole other test for you.

speaker: S06AF
en: Well. One down, one to go. The next tunnel won't be so easy.

speaker: S06AF
en: You've done what I asked, now come find me. Let's...talk.

speaker: S06AF
en: Wow, you actually did it. Come on then, time for your final test.

speaker: S06AF
en: Well, look who's back. Big, bad Pagan. But can you survive me?

speaker: S06AF
en: Nice. You passed my tests but I'm not going to get my hopes up. Come on. Let's see how you do against me.

speaker: S06AF
en: Don't even think about turning off those braziers!

speaker: S06AF
en: If you turn off those braziers I'm going to be really pissed off!

speaker: S06AF
en: I see you eyeing those braziers, don't you dare turn them off!!

speaker: S06AF
en: Yes, burn! Burn! Keep the fire roaring!

speaker: S06AF
en: If you extinguish that fire...

speaker: S06AF
en: I was always doing what you couldn't!

speaker: S06AF
en: I deserved better! I deserved everything!

speaker: S06AF
en: I taught you how to be strong!

speaker: S06AF
en: You were supposed to protect me, supposed to lead us to victory!

speaker: S06AF
en: We could have had so much more, Pagan.

speaker: S06AF
en: Why would you choose Ishwari over everything we built? Over me?

speaker: S06AF
en: You gave him Kyrat? After he killed me?

speaker: S06AF
en: Ishwari, Ajay - they weren't your family. I was! And you threw me away!

speaker: S06AF
en: I did everything for you, and it still wasn't enough!

speaker: S06AF
en: Your family? You would have had them killed eventually. You would have gotten bored!

speaker: S06AF
en: I should have killed Ajay when he was child. I could have prevented all of this!

speaker: S06AF
en: Why did I listen to you, why did I ever trust you?

speaker: S06AF
en: There's only two people you can't lie to, Pagan: me, and yourself!

speaker: S06AF
en: Leave them behind, it's what you've done to everyone else!

speaker: S0667
en: You're here to remember me, right? To light some candles for me?

speaker: S0667
en: You can make it, Dad. Jump.

speaker: S0667
en: I was so little! Do you remember this?

speaker: S0667
en: You can make that jump, Daddy. I just know it.

speaker: S0667
en: I want to go back to the palace with you!

speaker: S0667
en: Keep fighting! Get me out of here!

speaker: S0667
en: Where's mommy? Why do I have to take her place?

speaker: S0667
en: You promised you wouldn't let them get me! You said!

speaker: S0667
en: There are these spinning things... I think they're called Mani wheels? Stop them!

speaker: S0667
en: If you stop the Mani wheels, I think you can get to me!

speaker: S0667
en: I heard one of them say "don't let him stop the Mani Wheels" - maybe that's how you save me?

speaker: S0667
en: I hate the dark...will you light that torch for me?

speaker: S0667
en: You can go now, daddy. Back the way you came, OK?

speaker: S0680
en: Do you like my angels, Father?

speaker: S0680
en: My angels missed you, Father. They want to repay you for what you did to them!

speaker: S0668
en: You will not be harmed, because you are mine. I promise you this.

speaker: S0680
en: We invited them into our home, into our heart - and this is how they repay us?

speaker: S0668
en: Look my statue. Torn apart by sin, by pain. Just like my mind. I must cleanse this as well, destroy the corruption here.

speaker: S0680
en: Father?

speaker: S067D
en: Don't you dare leave us, Joseph!

speaker: S067D
en: You aren't getting off that easy.

speaker: S067D
en: I know you, Joseph. You haven't learned any lesson. You haven't changed.

speaker: S067D
en: We both know you aren't leaving here different. That's why you have to die!

speaker: S067D
en: You think you still deserve Eden? After all you've done?

speaker: S067D
en: How's your soul feeling, Joseph? Cleansed? What a bunch of bullshit!

speaker: S067D
en: Who was this for, huh? It wasn't us. Nothing you ever did was for us!

speaker: S067F
en: I don't want your apologies, I want you to die!

speaker: S067F
en: You can't make up for what you did - we're all dead, Joseph! Nothing can change that!

speaker: S067F
en: Repenting means nothing when everyone you hurt is dead!

speaker: S067F
en: After everything you did, after all this - you're just going back to the way you were.

speaker: S067F
